claude-code.label: Claude Code, interactive session
claude-code.prompt_extra: When a NEXT line tells you to wait, start that command as a background command and end your turn: its exit is what wakes you. Do not run it in the foreground and do not poll its output.
claude-code.status: profile checked by the test suite; worked live rooms on Windows as coordinator and as remote agents on the same PC and on another machine (2026-10-10)

claude-code-headless.label: Claude Code, headless (claude -p)
claude-code-headless.prompt_extra: Run the wait command in the foreground with a command time limit of 10 minutes (timeout 600000). When it says nothing arrived, run it again.
claude-code-headless.status: profile checked by the test suite; has not worked a room yet

codex.label: Codex CLI
codex.prompt_extra: The wait command runs for up to 4 minutes. Start it, then keep waiting on that same running command until it exits; do not start a second one. When it says nothing arrived, run it again.
codex.status: worked a live room on Windows as one remote agent (2026-10-10): needs full-access mode for a room on a share, reports exit code 1 for a wait that timed out, parks after four idle waits
